title: Gaussian Minkowski content
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and $A\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n$. The Gaussian Minkowski content of $A$ is the limit inferior, as $\varepsilon$ tends to zero through positive values, of $\gamma_n\bigl(\{x\in\mathbb{R}^n:\operatorname{dist}(x,\partial A)\leq\varepsilon/2\}\bigr)/\varepsilon$, where $\gamma_n$ is standard Gaussian measure and distance is Euclidean.
